inspiration: A low-memory software renderer with one global quality flag (Rasterizer3D.java lines 11 and 14). Idea: one switch that drops expensive paths, per device tier.
Precomputed angle and shading lookup tables instead of per-frame maths (Rasterizer3D.java lines 18, 20, 21). Idea: a lookup that drives a dusk-to-night colour ramp.
A priority-ordered queue of outstanding asset requests with a checksum on arrival (OnDemandRequester.java lines 21, 22, 27). Idea: zone chunks load by priority and are verified before use.
A keep-alive counter on the request connection (OnDemandRequester.java, field declared; body not read). Idea: a heartbeat for long asset sessions.
